import os

def get_token_transfers(account_address: str):
    api_key = os.environ.get("SOLANA_FM_API_KEY")
    
    solana_fm = SolanaFM(api_key=api_key)
    response = solana_fm.client.get_account_transfers(account_address)
    
    return response.result.data

if __name__ == "__main__":
    account = "8jirvnyMDhzuomvEpQLVu5LEZSp6rKKvnY9WgBpvRgdq"
    transfers = get_token_transfers(account)
    print(f"Retrieved {len(transfers)} token transfers")
